name: c15m-lv-seeps
description: maze s7, methane seeps (0.3/s each) beside the richest springs up to 16 springs

condition.name: c15m-lv-seeps
condition.description: maze s7, methane seeps (0.3/s each) beside the richest springs up to 16 springs

evals.js: const M = moire.matter, R = moire.cells.R; M.params.maxSprings = 16; const src = M.springs.filter((s) => s.kind === 'light' || s.kind === 'heavy').sort((a, b) => (b.rate || 0) - (a.rate || 0)); let n = 0; for (const s of src) { if (M.springs.length >= 16) break; M.addPatch(s.x + 2.5 * R, s.y, 'seep', 2.5, 0.3 / (Math.PI * 6.25), 1e9); M.springs[M.springs.length - 1].scene = true; n++; } return n

const L = moire.carbon && moire.carbon.ledger, H = moire.heat.ledger; return JSON.stringify({t: moire.time(), alive: moire.cells.alive, job: moire.cells.stats && moire.cells.stats.job, cRound: L && L.rounding, atoms: moire.matter.ledger.rounding, charge: moire.charge.ledger ? moire.charge.ledger.qRound : null, energy: H.rounding, springs: moire.matter.springs.length})
